CheckTitle: Okta FastPass is enabled as a device-bound method
Description: Checks that Okta FastPass signed_nonce authentication is active.
Risk: Without FastPass, Okta Verify may be limited to weaker push or OTP methods instead of device-bound authentication.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authenticators.
2. Open Okta Verify and edit Verification options.
3. Enable Okta FastPass for all required platforms.
4. Configure a global session policy and app sign-in policy that allow or require Okta FastPass.
5. Deploy Okta Verify and enrollment guidance to workforce users.

Recommendation.Text: Enable Okta FastPass through Okta Verify so users can use a device-bound authentication method.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
